Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for your time on today's discovery call. Helpful to understand FintechCo's priorities around latency, cost, and private deployment needs for your customer-facing features. As discussed, the next step would be a technical demo + a short SE-led deep dive to validate integration points and sizing.

Proposed next steps:
- 45-minute demo (product + SE) to walk through routing, autoscaling, and private deployment options
- Share a short agenda and a draft SOW for scope estimates

Are you available for any of these options (PDT)?
- Thu, Aug 20 — 10:00–10:45 AM
- Thu, Aug 20 — 2:00–2:45 PM
- Fri, Aug 21 — 11:00–11:45 AM

If none of these work, please share a couple of windows that do and we’ll tighten confirmation on our side (we’ll send an invite and ask for an explicit accept). I can also share a Calendly link if that's easier: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

I attached a short draft SOW and a proposed agenda to help frame the conversation.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Marissa Cole
